items.label: Undo window (seconds)
items.description: How long after a change its author may undo it.
items.long_description: history::undo takes back the caller's own last change to a record while it is still the last one and no older than this. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Keep history (days)
items.description: How long record versions are kept; 0 keeps them forever.
items.long_description: Applies to models that do not set their own history.keep_days. Old versions are folded into a snapshot, so the record can still be read as it was from the cut-off on. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Most records searched as of a time
items.description: db::find with as_of refuses a model with more records than this.
items.long_description: Searching the past rebuilds every record that existed then, so it is bounded. Use a saved report snapshot for larger models. Organizations can override the global default.
